strings.name: Michael Widenius
strings.role: MySQL cofounder and MariaDB company CTO
strings.summary: Michael Widenius is a Finnish programmer known as Monty in the database community. He helped create MySQL, advanced the MariaDB fork and community, and helped establish the MariaDB Foundation. His technical and organizational work involves many developers.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Company and foundation, project start and first release, and acquisition announcement and completion are distinguished. Conflicting early MySQL dates are omitted from the precise timeline.
strings.influence.rationale: Cocreated MySQL and advanced MariaDB, influencing open database software and internet application infrastructure.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education and technical writing
strings.facts.f1.value: Studied at Helsinki University of Technology and coauthored the MySQL Reference Manual; attendance is not described as an earned degree.
strings.facts.f2.label: Organizational roles
strings.facts.f2.value: CTO of the MariaDB company and ex-officio founder director of the MariaDB Foundation; Anna Widenius is the foundation CEO.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Open database infrastructure
strings.highlights.h1.text: Helped develop MySQL and MariaDB as relational database tools for internet applications; collective achievements are not assigned solely to him.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Community governance
strings.highlights.h2.text: Helped establish an independent foundation supporting sustained collaboration among database contributors and users.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Speaks at Zurich technical event
strings.timeline.t1.text: VSHN’s October 28 recap describes his talk on MySQL and MariaDB history; event and reporting dates are distinct.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Foundation minutes confirm board role
strings.timeline.t2.text: Listed as absent in his ex-officio founder role; this record does not establish personal attendance.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Reflects on fifteen years of MariaDB
strings.timeline.t3.text: His signed article reviews origins and technical evolution, emphasizing teamwork behind the first release.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Jointly announces MariaDB Foundation
strings.timeline.t4.text: Announces the foundation with David Axmark and Allan Larsson; the release names him interim CTO.
strings.timeline.t5.title: First MariaDB release
strings.timeline.t5.text: His retrospective identifies version 5.1.38 as the first release; first release and stable general availability are distinct.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Starts MariaDB project
strings.timeline.t6.text: His retrospective dates the start to Oracle’s announcement of plans to buy Sun, not the acquisition closing date.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Sun completes MySQL AB acquisition
strings.timeline.t7.text: The transaction follows plans announced in January; his MySQL technical leadership and later MariaDB work are distinguished.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Finnish software entrepreneur award
strings.timeline.t8.text: Company and foundation biographies record his Software Entrepreneur of the Year recognition.
